Vehicle lighting: - Automatic lighting switches between dipped beam and daytime running lights depending on ambient light.
- Main beam can be activated manually using the left-hand lever.
- Main beam assistant (if equipped) automatically toggles high beams for oncoming traffic.
- Front fog lights improve visibility in foggy conditions.
- Rear fog light increases rear visibility in dense fog.
- Static cornering lights activate at low speeds to illuminate turns.
- Daytime running lights are on when the ignition is active and headlights are off.
- Parking lights can be switched on manually when parked.
- Hazard warning lights activate all turn signals and should be used in emergencies.
- Turn signals indicate changes in direction and lane changes.
- Light settings and preferences can be adjusted via the infotainment system.
Interior lights: - Front and rear reading lights can be activated manually by pressing the light itself.
- Ambient lighting enhances cabin comfort and visibility at night.
- Footwell lighting and door handle illumination may be available depending on trim.
- Interior lights switch on automatically when doors are opened or the vehicle is unlocked.
- Delayed switch-off function allows lights to remain on briefly after door closure.
- Brightness of ambient lighting can be adjusted in the infotainment system.
- Lighting profiles may vary based on driving mode or user preferences.
